title: AI Agents Will Buy Off-Plan Real Estate: Lessons From the Trading Floor
seoTitle: AI Agents Will Buy Off-Plan Real Estate
description: An investor may soon buy presale units through an AI agent, with no gallery or broker. Why the stock exchange shows where off-plan real estate is heading.
answer: In a few years, an investor may buy several presale units in another country without visiting a sales gallery or speaking to a broker. Their AI agent will deal with the developer's AI agent and close before launch. The stock exchange already went this way: humans left the trading floor because machines were faster, cheaper and never emotional.
body:
Picture an investor in Dubai who buys ten units in a presale tower in Miami. They never visit the sales gallery. They never talk to a broker. In fact, they never talk to a human at all. Their AI agent talks to the developer's AI agent, and the deal is done before the launch event even starts.

## Why this is not science fiction

I used to think this sounded like a movie. I do not anymore. In my opinion, this is where off-plan real estate is clearly going. The question is not whether it happens, but how fast.

## What the stock exchange already showed us

Think of the New York Stock Exchange in the 1980s. The floor was packed with people shouting, waving papers, holding a phone in each hand. If you wanted to buy a stock, you needed a human to do it for you.

The same floor today is quiet. Most trades happen through algorithms in milliseconds. The people did not leave because anyone disliked them. They left because the investor did not need them anymore. The machine was:

- Faster
- Cheaper
- Never tired
- Never emotional

## Why real estate moves slower, but in the same direction

Property is bigger, more complex and far more local than a share of stock, so the change will take longer. But the direction is the same. Investors will be first, because they decide on numbers, and numbers are exactly what machines handle best.

For developers, the practical lesson is simple: if a machine is going to be the first buyer you meet, your project has to be easy for that machine to read and check.

This preview covers the first minute of the episode. For the three stages of this shift and what developers should do now, listen to the full episode at [/podcast/off-plan-buyers-will-send-ai-agents/](/podcast/off-plan-buyers-will-send-ai-agents/).
takeaways: Investors may soon buy presale units through AI agents without visiting a gallery or speaking to a broker.
The buyer's AI agent could negotiate directly with the developer's AI agent.
Stock trading already moved from shouting humans to fast algorithms.
Real estate will change more slowly because property is complex and local, but in the same direction.
Developers need projects that machines can easily read and check.
faq: Can AI agents buy real estate?
AI agents can already research and compare properties. In my view, it is only a matter of time before they also negotiate and complete purchases for investors.
Will AI replace real estate sales galleries?
For investors buying on data, the sales gallery may stop being the first point of contact, because their AI agent will screen projects first.
Why compare real estate to the stock market?
Stock trading shows how a human-run market moved to machines once they became faster and cheaper, and real estate is following a similar path more slowly.
